name: shopcar
description: ShopCar - car showroom: Express API, React customer website and admin dashboard

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client-customer && npm install --prefix client-admin
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,admin -c red,blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client-customer" "npm run dev --prefix client-admin"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client-customer && npm run build --prefix client-admin
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client-customer && npm test --prefix client-admin
scripts.test:web: npm test --prefix client-customer && npm test --prefix client-admin
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
